subtitle: Lesson 10 · Why tracking is a shared service, not a habit

eyebrow: Four things every run needs logged

code:
import mlflow
mlflow.set_experiment("fraud-detection")

with mlflow.start_run():
    mlflow.log_param("max_depth", 8)
    mlflow.log_metric("val_auc", 0.91, step=5)
    mlflow.log_artifact("confusion_matrix.png")
caption: One run, one with block: params logged once, metrics logged per step, artifacts attached as files.
